NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that, pursuant to Local Civil Rule 7, Plaintiff Marvelle J.
Ballentine, proceeding pro se, waives oral argument on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second
Amended and Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a)(2) and
15(d), and Request for Expedited Determination on the Papers, filed contemporaneously with this
Notice.

Plaintiff requests that the Motion be determined on the papers upon completion of the

briefing permitted by Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1).
